title: Godot crashes when launching editor with OpenGL 3 backend.
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.3.stable
- Not reproducible in: 4.4.beta1, 4.2.2.stable

### System information

Godot v4.2.2.stable - Debian GNU/Linux 12 (bookworm) 12 - Wayland - GLES3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon Vega 11 Graphics (raven, LLVM 15.0.6, DRM 3.59, 6.12.9+bpo-amd64) () - AMD Ryzen 5 2400G with Radeon Vega Graphics (8 Threads)

### Issue description

Launching Godot Engine (v4.3.stable) with the OpenGL 3 rendering backend causes it to crash before displaying the project list or the splash screen. Launching the editor directly (using the ``--editor`` argument) does not result in a different outcome.

Executing the Godot Engine editor binary with `--rendering-driver=opengl3` or no arguments results in the following error:


I also tested `--rendering-driver` options such as `opengl3_es` and `vulkan`, they do not result in any errors, crashes or graphical glitches (that i know of).

The engine started crashing after i added more RAM sticks (might be irrelevant). I'm unable to reproduce the crash on different Linux distributions (tried Arch Linux) on the same machine.
This issue seems to not be reproducible, it might be caused by my machine configuration but i'm not sure myself.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Launch Godot Engine (optionally add `--rendering-driver=opengl3`)
